name: Complete the guided order and continue freely
description: Verify real order actions drive all seven guide steps and the bench without skipping prerequisites.
steps: Open the landing page and click להדגמה המודרכת.
Click מעבר לטיפול. Verify מעבר למוכן is disabled, check הפריטים מוכנים, and click מעבר למוכן.
Verify the gate is closed and מוכנות ליציאה is 0. Set מועד אספקה to 2026-12-01 and verify the gate remains closed.
Click סימון תשלום בדמו. Verify the gate opens, paid amount equals total, and מוכנות ליציאה becomes 1.
Click יציאה למשלוח then השלמת המסירה. Inspect the history and final guide step.
Click עכשיו נסו הזמנה משלכם, then close the creation dialog.
expected: The guide reaches step 7 of 7 through actual actions; DEMO-1001 is completed with an audit history, and its state remains completed in free exploration.

name: Create and find an order on mobile
description: Verify mobile form validation, order creation, combined filtering and Escape dismissal.
steps: Open התנסות חופשית and click הזמנת הדגמה חדשה.
Clear שם לקוח פיקטיבי and submit; verify the dialog remains open. Enter לקוח בדיקת רצף, set amount to 0 and submit; verify creation is still blocked.
Set amount to 450 and submit. Verify the created order is selected.
Click כל ההזמנות (4), search for לקוח בדיקת רצף and verify one result. Filter to מוכן and verify empty results.
Restore הכול, clear search, return to ההזמנה הנבחרת, reopen the creation dialog and press Escape.
expected: Invalid forms create no records; the valid order has התקבל status and 450 ₪ total. Mobile tabs, combined filters and Escape work without page overflow.

name: Hold, resume and cancel with reasons
description: Verify exceptional actions require a reason and stay separate from forward progression.
steps: Open free exploration and click איפוס הדמו.
Open פעולות נוספות, choose השהיה, and verify אישור השהיה is disabled without a reason.
Enter ממתינים לאישור לקוח and confirm. Verify held status and closed gate, then click מעבר להתקבל.
Open פעולות נוספות if collapsed, choose ביטול הזמנה, and verify אישור ביטול is disabled without a reason.
Enter ביטול בדיקה and confirm. Inspect controls and history.
expected: Holding preserves the prior station and allows resuming there; cancellation records its reason and leaves no further status actions.

name: Use the guide on mobile with reduced motion
description: Verify the mobile guided flow remains usable without animation.
steps: Enable reduced motion in the test browser and open the guided demo.
Verify Hebrew RTL and absence of horizontal page overflow.
Use keyboard navigation to reach and activate מעבר לטיפול.
Check the guide changes to preparation, the bench says בטיפול, and the next disabled action explains missing preparation.
expected: The guide and textual bench state update without requiring animation. The primary action is reachable and focus is visible; no horizontal page scrolling is needed.

name: Reset and reload discard only demo session changes
description: Verify reset and refresh restore fictional data and the app has no provider dependencies.
steps: Open free exploration and mark the selected order paid.
Refresh and verify it is unpaid again.
Create an order named לקוח איפוס, then click איפוס הדמו.
Verify exactly three original orders remain, the first is selected, search is cleared and dispatch count is 0.
Use the brand link to return home, then browser Back to return to free exploration; inspect browser errors and network.
expected: Reload and explicit reset restore initial fictional data. Route navigation works, no uncaught frontend errors occur, and no external provider requests are made.
